default/32053.htm.text: Railroad Worker Abey: Hi! Nice weather, eh? We always have nice weather in these parts! What brings you way out here?

Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32053-01.h.text: Railroad Worker Abey: Hey stranger, would you do me a favor? I keep hearing strange noises around here every night! Obi says he doesn't know anything about it. Could you find out what's going on around here?

Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32053-03.h.text: Railroad Worker Abey: Well, to tell you the truth, I don't think you're up to it! I can see you have some experience, but not enough. Come back later. (Characters must have achieved at least level 39 to undertake this quest.)

Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32053-04.h.text: Railroad Worker Abey: Please, check out what is making all the noises around here at night. I'm sure you'll make it possible for me to sleep like a baby tonight!

Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32053-05.h.text: Railroad Worker Abey: Well, you must have done a good job! I slept like a log last night! What was making that noise?

links.text: "Well, you see, there was this Dwarven ghost, and a strange hammer..."

Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32053-07.h.text: Railroad Worker Abey: That hammer might be in the box in the back . We keep a lot of old odds-and-ends there.

Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32053-08.h.text: Railroad Worker Abey: Is this the hammer? Wow! Look how rusty it is! It seems familiar to me somehow. The Black Anvil doesn't use hammers this large, but our Grey Pillar Guild does! These engravings are also of the Grey Pillar... But what are those strange stars? Oh! I've got it! I think Obi might …

Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32053-10.h.text: Railroad Worker Abey: Railroad worker Obi must know about that hammer!

Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32053-02.h.text: Railroad Worker Abey: Oh, thank you! I haven't slept in weeks! I'm afraid those noises might mean something very bad! I'm sure you'll make it possible for me to finally get a good night's sleep! Good luck!

Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32053-06.h.text: Railroad Worker Abey: A ghost? Eeek! Oh, excuse me! I'm so sorry! I'm just deathly afraid of ghosts! But... The hammer! If we find that hammer, the ghost will go away, right? ... I think it's in a box in the back . We keep a lot of old odds-and-ends in there.

Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32053-09.h.text: Railroad Worker Abey: Please go and ask Obi about that hammer!
